items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: And with O'Gees. And after... I'd gone to New Orleans and lived a while. They would send for me from New Orleans to come over out here and play with him.

ctx.x: Well, he was a drummer around here. He was a player of Ogies. Ogies. Ogies Sosia. Ogies Sosia. Ogies Sosia. Uh-huh. His name is August Sosia, but he called him Ogies, you know. Oh yeah, I know that.
I know that name. I hear that. Yeah. Or Ryan Lewand, the same style of talk. Yeah. That's right. Uh, so, tell me a little bit more. Did you play on regular stedal drums or were you just called it?
